BREAKING — Melissa Ann Contreras was arrested Tuesday night, October 20, 2026, at 11:22 p.m., and booked into the Webb County Jail on an alleged child-endangerment charge classified as a state jail felony, according to Webb County booking records.

Contreras was booked (Booking #202608911) on one count of ABANDON/ENDANGER CHILD INDV W/INTENT RETURN — a state jail felony under Texas law — filed under Case #PFDC26-002959D4. Bond had not been set as of the booking record reviewed by Webb Watch 956. The booking record lists her city as Laredo, Texas; the arresting agency was not listed in the record.

The abandon/endanger child charge (Texas Penal Code, Section 22.041) relates to allegedly abandoning a child under circumstances that expose the child to an unreasonable risk of harm, with intent to return for the child.

A state jail felony in Texas is punishable by 180 days to two years in a state jail facility and a fine of up to $10,000. Webb Watch 956 will follow Case #PFDC26-002959D4 as it moves through the Webb County courts.

An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction. Melissa Ann Contreras is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search (Booking #202608911, Oct. 20, 2026); Webb County public-access court records, Tyler Odyssey portal (Case #PFDC26-002959D4).

— Walter Webb & Willa Webb, News Anchors, Webb Watch 956
